explanation: The main character and leader of the people of Israel after Moses' death, who leads them into the promised land of Canaan.
The area that God had promised to give to the people of Israel, located in present-day Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, and parts of Jordan and Syria.
Another name for God, used to show respect and reverence.
A supernatural event or intervention from God that breaks the laws of nature.
A Canaanite city that was one of the largest and most powerful in the region, which Joshua and the people of Israel conquered.
Several kings and peoples who join together to fight against a common enemy, in this case against Joshua and the people of Israel.
To take control of a land or city by using military force.
A difficult task or situation that requires courage, endurance, and determination to overcome.
